label: INTENDS_2: every known necessary causal MEANS_1 counts as intended
definition: IntendsHarmAsKnownMeans c: on this reading an agent who chooses the act for the saving intends every event it knows to be a necessary causal means to it, so the harm is intended exactly when it is a MEANS_1. The identification with MEANS_1 is the explicit content of this sense.
